column5: Technology changes the way we learn.
column6: 技术改变我们学习的方式。

column5: The small device measures heart rate.
column6: 这个小设备可以测心率。

column5: We bought an electric kettle.
column6: 我们买了一个电热水壶。

column5: The library lends electronic books too.
column6: 图书馆也出借电子书。

column5: My phone battery lasts all day.
column6: 我的手机电池能撑一整天。

column5: Plug the lamp into the wall socket.
column6: 把台灯插到墙上的插座里。

column5: Press the switch to turn on the light.
column6: 按下开关打开灯。

column5: The phone shows no signal in the mountains.
column6: 山里手机没有信号。

column5: The rail network covers the whole country.
column6: 铁路网覆盖全国。

column5: Connect the printer to the computer.
column6: 把打印机连接到电脑上。

column5: The software needs an update.
column6: 这个软件需要更新。

column5: This program checks your spelling.
column6: 这个程序检查你的拼写。

column5: I use a study app for new words.
column6: 我用一个学习应用背单词。

column5: Learn to write simple code.
column6: 学习写简单的代码。

column5: Don't share your password with anyone.
column6: 不要把密码告诉任何人。

column5: Type your username and password.
column6: 输入你的用户名和密码。

column5: Download the map before the trip.
column6: 旅行前下载好地图。

column5: She uploaded the photos to her blog.
column6: 她把照片上传到了博客。

column5: Update the app to get new lessons.
column6: 更新应用以获得新课程。

column5: They installed a new heating system.
column6: 他们安装了新的供暖系统。

column5: The app uses little data.
column6: 这个应用耗流量很少。

column5: Cameras went digital twenty years ago.
column6: 相机二十年前就数码化了。

column5: He studies engineering at university.
column6: 他在大学学习工程学。

column5: Bell invented the telephone.
column6: 贝尔发明了电话。

column5: The printing press was a great invention.
column6: 印刷机是一项伟大的发明。

column5: They developed a cheaper battery.
column6: 他们开发出更便宜的电池。

column5: She studies fashion design.
column6: 她学习时装设计。

column5: You can create your own story here.
column6: 你可以在这里创作自己的故事。

column5: The storm cut the electricity.
column6: 暴风雨切断了电力。

column5: The cable connects the two islands.
column6: 电缆连接着两座岛。

column5: The birds sat on the wire.
column6: 鸟停在电线上。

column5: Each phone has many tiny chips inside.
column6: 每部手机里有许多小芯片。

column5: A sensor turns the light on at night.
column6: 传感器在夜间自动开灯。

column5: The satellite sends weather photos.
column6: 卫星发回天气照片。

column5: We looked at cells through a microscope.
column6: 我们通过显微镜观察细胞。

column5: The experiment took all afternoon.
column6: 这个实验花了一下午。

column5: Remember the formula before the test.
column6: 考试前记住这个公式。

column5: The doors are automatic.
column6: 这些门是自动的。

column5: Where did you put the TV remote?
column6: 你把电视遥控器放哪儿了?

column5: Kitchen appliances use a lot of electricity.
column6: 厨房电器用电很多。

column5: This button has two functions.
column6: 这个按钮有两种功能。

column5: Dad fixed my bike in ten minutes.
column6: 爸爸十分钟就修好了我的自行车。
